dedupe_keys.name: ribasim simulated danube river discharge under reference and what if scenarios

description: The STARS4Water deposit gives RIBASIM-simulated Danube discharge at selected water-allocation nodes. Its public XLSX workbook separates a 2010 to 2020 reference from what-if conditions around 2050, with values on the first, eleventh and twenty-first day of each month in cubic metres per second. The described nodes include low-flow sections, hydropower and nuclear plants, and public water-supply sites. These series can support water-allocation, cooling-water or hydropower stress simulations. The future series apply relative changes drawn from literature to the reference period; they are not a direct dated forecast. Upstream wflow_sbm hydrology from the DOORS project is a separate input. Zenodo marks the workbook CC BY 4.0 and public. A reuse limitation is that node identifiers are anonymised, and the spreadsheet and site mapping were not opened. The related catalogue wflow record is a general model, not this Danube output release.
